title: Sidi Yahya Mosque

terrainReference.basis: Grade on the exterior public approach beside the native footprint.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named Sidi Yahya Mosque way 308864956 and Wikidata Q2843735
mapIdentity.scope: Named native way 308864956 locates the hall and eastern mihrab. Adjoining native way 308864954 fixes the northwest envelope at the plaza. The low western court occupies the open strip south of that wing and east of the mapped street.

note: Rubble-like alhor stone, tapering mud-and-stone minaret with timber ends and rounded crest, low flat roof, thicker northern buttresses, recessed pointed portals, and open courts. Main eaves use the proportions of the historical image and the fixed map dimensions.
